text:
Priya Patel: LanternHealth escalated — seeing 503s/timeouts on Dedicated pool3 in us-west-2, customer case #98765. SLA window at risk. Can eng-platform commit to immediate mitigation and an ETA for full fix?
Marco Silva: I'm oncall, looking now. can you paste a sample request id / logs?
Priya Patel: sample req id `lf-9a2b3c`, stack trace attached in case, says output timeout after 8s. customer reporting ~5% request failures for last 20m :rotating_light:
Jordan Lee: quick check — pool3 autoscale is flapping, instances failing healthchecks during warmup. p99 tail latency spike aligns w/ recent traffic burst. Recommend temporary routing to burst-capacity or route LanternHealth to reserved-burst pool to stabilize.
Alice Nguyen: I can open a canary routing rule to point LanternHealth to reserved-burst in us-west-2. PR incoming, tagging @Marco for quick review. ETA 10–15m.
Marco Silva: can review in 5. also suggest increasing `min_replicas` for pool3 to avoid warmup churn. low-risk.
Alice Nguyen: PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/+/PR-3421 — adding canary route + bump min_replicas. Config snippet:
```
routing:
  match: "team == 'lantern' && region == 'us-west-2'"
  action: route-to-reserved-burst
```
Merging now.
deploy-bot: Started deploy of PR-3421 to infra-configs (canary). Logs: https://ci.internal/logs/PR-3421
Jordan Lee: monitoring p99 now. If errors persist we should fallback to a lighter model-variant for LanternHealth (quality hit but keeps SLA). Priya, can you confirm customer OK with temporary quality reduction?
Priya Patel: customer agrees to a lightweight fallback for up to 4 hours while we fix autoscale. they want updates every 30m.
Marco Silva: opening a rollback/runbook ticket. @Samai Rao please review autoscale heuristic change — it's urgent.
Samai Rao: on it, scanning PR. noticed unrelated qp-cache regression in `serve-core` that's increasing cold-starts. I'll patch in a follow-up PR, but autoscale bump should proceed.
Alice Nguyen: PR merged and canary applied. Triggering routing reload: `/deploy routing-config pool3-canary`
deploy-bot: routing-config pool3-canary applied successfully. Health checks passing on 6/6 pods. :white_check_mark:
Jordan Lee: quick metric: sample p99 for LanternHealth dropped from 1.2s -> 210ms after canary. errors at ~0.2% now. I'll keep monitoring.
Priya Patel: told customer, they acknowledged. Thanks team :pray:
Marco Silva: next steps: autoscale tune + qp-cache patch = full fix ETA ~6h. Will update every 30m or on regression. Owning: Marco (oncall) + Samai (autoscale/serve patch) + Alice (routing config).
Alice Nguyen: created tracking ticket https://tickets.internal/RED-1289 and assigned owners + ETA.
Jordan Lee: status update in 30m. current last_message_ts update.
